name: Hello Chat Action
description: Adds Hello and Fill buttons to the chat input bar. Demonstrates the chatAction extension point and session.when clauses.
installation_notes: In goose Desktop, open Add-ons, click Install add-on, and select this folder. When running from source, enable the dev example from Add-ons instead.

name: Hello Page
description: Adds a sidebar page under Add-on pages with custom HTML in the main content area. Demonstrates the rootLink extension point.
installation_notes: Install from the examples folder via Add-ons → Install add-on, then enable the add-on and open Hello Page from the sidebar.

name: Hello Sidecar
description: Adds a collapsible right-side panel on the chat route that receives session context from the host. Demonstrates the sidecar extension point.
installation_notes: Enable from Add-ons, open a chat session, and use the panel icon in the top-right to toggle the sidecar.

name: Message Decorations
description: Shows an image badge on messages with attachments and a formatted JSON preview for assistant replies with json code blocks.
installation_notes: Enable from Add-ons, then send a message with an image or ask goose to reply with a json code block.
